mapper.select: SELECT id, p_num, batch_num, supplier_id, production_date, expiry_date, inspection_status, reserve_level, batch_stock, locked_stock, in_num, create_time, modified_time, remark FROM biz_product_batch WHERE p_num = #{pNum} AND inspection_status = 1 AND batch_stock - locked_stock > 0 AND expiry_date >= CURDATE() ORDER BY expiry_date ASC, create_time ASC

SELECT b.id, b.p_num, b.batch_num, b.supplier_id, b.production_date, b.expiry_date, b.inspection_status, b.reserve_level, b.batch_stock, b.locked_stock, (b.batch_stock - b.locked_stock) AS available_stock, b.in_num, b.create_time, b.remark, DATEDIFF(b.expiry_date, CURDATE()) AS remaining_days, p.name AS product_name, s.name AS supplier_name FROM biz_product_batch b LEFT JOIN biz_product p ON b.p_num = p.p_num LEFT JOIN biz_supplier s ON b.supplier_id = s.id WHERE b.inspection_status = 1 AND b.batch_stock > 0 AND DATEDIFF(b.expiry_date, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 0 AND #{days} ORDER BY b.expiry_date ASC

SELECT b.batch_num, b.p_num, p.name AS product_name, s.name AS supplier_name, b.production_date, b.expiry_date, b.inspection_status, b.reserve_level, b.batch_stock, b.in_num, i.create_time AS in_stock_time, i.operator AS in_stock_operator FROM biz_product_batch b LEFT JOIN biz_product p ON b.p_num = p.p_num LEFT JOIN biz_supplier s ON b.supplier_id = s.id LEFT JOIN biz_in_stock i ON b.in_num = i.in_num WHERE b.batch_num = #{batchNum} LIMIT 1

SELECT b.id, b.p_num, b.batch_num, b.supplier_id, b.production_date, b.expiry_date, b.inspection_status, b.reserve_level, b.batch_stock, b.locked_stock, (b.batch_stock - b.locked_stock) AS available_stock, b.in_num, b.create_time, b.remark, DATEDIFF(b.expiry_date, CURDATE()) AS remaining_days, p.name AS product_name, s.name AS supplier_name FROM biz_product_batch b LEFT JOIN biz_product p ON b.p_num = p.p_num LEFT JOIN biz_supplier s ON b.supplier_id = s.id WHERE 1=1
AND b.p_num = #{pNum}
AND b.batch_num LIKE concat('%', #{batchNum}, '%')
ORDER BY b.create_time DESC
